warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the general-relativistic canonical Poisson-bracket path: the Schwarzschild metric and its inverse in the Hamiltonian, the only GR driver of the module. In `rt_gr_can_pb_schwarzschild_bh_geodesics.c`, `latus_rectum` (line 114) is `latus_rectum` sets the initial orbit (with the eccentricity) and therefore the initial distribution; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong metric component, a wrong lapse or a wrong Hamiltonian flux changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 8.5e-5 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 8.0e-6 (worst files `neut-m0.gkyl` and `neut-m1-from-h.gkyl`), a headroom of about 11771x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
